params.resolution: Chrome MV3 mandates background.service_worker and ignores or rejects event pages, whereas Firefox MV3 runs background.scripts event pages and ignores/rejects background.service_worker. Cross-browser extensions resolve this by persisting state in browser.storage.session and generating dual background keys or per-target manifests (e.g. WXT -b chrome / -b firefox) behind a single RPC interface.
